text: Consumer backport now committed in PLS Neuro ui/paired-surface-views@5e7ce3c, patch81082ac1 on basefd992a0. Exact native camera/layout source is reused with final-RGB/adaptive semantics retained. The first backport native run exposed an omitted dependency: compiler NearFar depth coefficients. That native calculation and camera-key depth suffix are now included. Also found JavaFxPairedNativeProbe's full-clip check permitted hits>15 even for its clipped stage; tightening it to require zero hits in the source native candidate and consumer copy. Earlier backport68-stage result is diagnostic only; fresh JVM/JS/app checks and stricter native run underway. Native V1 scene capture explicitly refuses per-surface cameras; application navigation recipes save them explicitly while preserving old sparse global defaults. No native-main, app-main or renderer-admission claim.
